meta.name: apple-search-ads
meta.description: Plans, launches, and optimizes Apple Search Ads (Apple Ads, ASA) campaigns for iOS apps: bids, keywords, budgets, CPA, attribution. Use for paid iOS user acquisition and App Store ads — launching or restructuring campaigns, mining search-term reports, graduating keywords, defending brand terms, scaling spend, expanding to new countries, testing Custom Product Pages, wiring AdServices or SKAdNetwork attribution, automating reports and changes via the Campaign Management API, or diagnosing why CPA spiked, keywords get no impressions, a campaign stops spending its budget, ads got rejected, or ASA, SKAN, and MMP install counts disagree. Not for App Store listing optimization itself (ASO).

copy.tagline: 计划并优化苹果搜索广告活动，提升应用下载量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责iOS应用在App Store的付费广告投放与优化
copy.tagline_en: Plan and optimize Apple Search Ads campaigns to boost iOS app downloads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run paid iOS user acquisition campaigns on the App Store

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude能管理Apple Search Ads广告活动：制定计划、调整出价关键词预算、分析搜索词报告、诊断投放问题，并通过API自动执行操作。
howto.when: 当你要求启动或优化iOS应用的Apple Search Ads活动、诊断投放问题或设置归因时，Claude会接管相关操作。

say.text: 帮我检查为什么我的Search Ads活动没有展示。
优化我品牌词的关键词出价，目标CPA是6美元。
say.note: Claude会根据LTV计算最大出价并调整。

say.text: 生成上周的搜索词报告，并建议需要添加的关键词。
say.note: Claude会运行报告并给出建议。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can manage Apple Search Ads campaigns: plan launches, adjust bids/keywords/budgets, analyze search term reports, diagnose issues, and automate tasks via the API.
howto.when_en: When you ask to start or optimize an iOS app's Search Ads campaign, diagnose performance issues, or set up attribution, Claude will handle the relevant actions.

say_en.text: Check why my Search Ads campaign has zero impressions.
Optimize my brand keyword bids with a target CPA of $6.
say_en.note: Claude will compute max CPT and adjust.

say_en.text: Generate last week's search term report and suggest keywords to add.
say_en.note: Claude will run the report and provide suggestions.
